Meet Blub

Why we built a fan game

Blub is a small, blue, always-hopping block from The Sift, a brand-new pink dimension. We fell for it the moment it hopped into view. The update that opens The Sift is still a while away, so we built a place for the fans in the meantime: a free game, a coin the community runs itself and a corner of the internet to share the hype.

Walk Blub’s road through The Sift

  • Free to playno fees and no stakes
  • Built togetherby the community, in the open

Connect your wallet to play

Your wallet is your player account: it keeps your team of 5, lets you duel real players and puts you in the weekly league.

Read-only and safe

  • Read-only: Blub only sees your public wallet address.
  • No transaction, no fees: you sign a short sign-in message, nothing else.
  • Your coins stay put: signing in cannot move tokens or NFTs, or approve anything.
  • Keep your seed phrase secret: Blub never asks for it. Anyone who does is a scammer.

$BLUB

$BLUB is a community memecoin with no intrinsic value: it is not an investment, and nothing on this site is financial advice. This fan game exists to grow the fanbase and the hype around the update. We are fans, in no way linked to, endorsed by or connected with the project Blub comes from or the companies that develop it. Prices come live from DexScreener; tokenized stocks are not available in every country.
